decisions.llmReasoning: Completely different work scopes: replacing towel bars/accessories vs. an independent plumbing leak test post-repair. Different trades, different actions, different purposes.

Installing a permanent crawl space dehumidifier is fundamentally different from installing moisture monitoring sensors. Different equipment, different function, different quantities, and significantly different costs.

Content manipulation (moving items) in the living room is entirely different from hardwood moisture content verification. Different trades, different actions, and different zone names with no obvious equivalence.

Emergency moisture mapping (initial assessment of entire structure) is different from moisture meter readings on walls in a specific bedroom. Different zones, different scope, different purpose, and different totals.

Crawl space drainage mat installation (physical material installation, 2200 sq ft) is fundamentally different from post-remediation air sampling (testing/verification, 2 samples). Completely different work types despite similar zone.

Blower motor cleaning is a specific mechanical cleaning task, while HVAC airflow balance test post-remediation is a diagnostic/testing service. Different actions, different purposes, and different costs.

Mold protocol documentation and photos (internal documentation) is different from third-party mold clearance laboratory analysis (external lab testing). Different scope, different quantities (1 vs 4), and significantly different totals ($462 vs $1254).
